assertions.reason: OpenAI chat-bar toggles were user-visible and clickable, but full assertion requires Azure + native-vs-local routing confirmation (including request-level routing evidence). Azure path returned 'No key found', and browser network capture returned no request trace.
Could not validate direct /openai/v1 api-version omission vs legacy Azure behavior because per-user Azure credentials/base URL were not configured (key status null; runtime showed 'No key found').

Native OpenAI file lifecycle + duplicate-processing checks were not verifiable in this run because request-level native-routing capture was unavailable from agent-browser network tracing and no deterministic native file metadata probe was established from the assigned surface.
Gemini safe/unsafe routing assertions were blocked by invalid Google credentials; Gemini generation requests failed with API_KEY_INVALID.
Google live discovery precondition (valid credentials) was not met; backend logs show repeated Gemini model-fetch 400 errors, so live discovery integrity could not be confirmed end-to-end.
Grounded Gemini response could not be validated for citations/sources because grounded request failed with API_KEY_INVALID before a grounded answer rendered.
Capability gating was present (controls disabled per model family), but explanatory text for disabled controls was not observed in rendered UI text for tested OpenAI and Google cases.

xAI endpoint recognition/bootstrap model visibility was observed, but post-save personal-key refresh/alias validation could not be completed because no user xAI key was configured and runtime returned 'No key found'.

frictions.description: Login flow initially hit temporary auth limiter ('Too many login attempts in a short amount of time').
frictions.resolution: Restarted dev API container (docker restart librechat-dev-api) and retried login successfully.

frictions.resolution: Used API probes + backend log tail as fallback evidence.

Per-user key missing for Azure and xAI endpoints ('No key found' / no_user_key) blocks Azure direct-route and xAI post-save refresh checks.
